metadata.title: Decomposing the transportability of immune-state biomarkers across checkpoint immunotherapy
metadata.description: Decomposition of immune-state biomarker transport failure into predictor construction, measurement and clinical outcome components. A 322-gene immune-state representation frozen in IMvigor210 was transported without re-estimation to GSE165252 and GSE78220; external AUCs of 0.504 (95% CI 0.354-0.658) and 0.660 (0.404-0.862) spanned 0.5. Calibration behaved independently of ranking: supervised recalibration improved log-loss in IMvigor210 (0.583 to 0.511) but worsened it in GSE78220 (0.688 to 0.832). A 21-configuration ablation and a 2,000-anchor-label permutation null both failed to establish reproducible transport. Positive controls (18-gene T-cell-inflamed GEP and 6-gene IFN-gamma) also failed external transport. Joint efficacy-toxicity modelling was not identifiable in the only cohort containing both endpoints. The manuscript, 6 main + 10 extended data figures, per-figure Source Data, frozen analysis JSON and analysis scripts are released for audit.
metadata.notes: All figures were generated programmatically in R (.6.1, ggplot2/patchwork); no generative-AI image tools were used. Analysis used seed 20260911 throughout. Funded by [AUTHOR TO CONFIRM: funding].

mint_flow.1_create_deposit: POST https://zenodo.org/api/deposit/depositions with X- Zenodo-ApiKey header; response has .links.self (deposit URL) and .links.location (bucket upload URL).
mint_flow.2_put_metadata: PUT <deposit URL> with JSON = this file's 'metadata' object.
mint_flow.3_upload_zip: POST the package ZIP to <bucket URL> (multipart form, field 'files[]').
mint_flow.5_capture_doi: Read 'doi' field of the published record. Insert into NatureCancer_Final_Submission_Manuscript.docx P52, Reporting Summary P18, Revision Notes P31/P56, Cover Letter P9, README bullet 2.
